example_label: Example data. Fictional agency and AI system. Not a real assessment.

answers.q5_changes: State staff connected the drafter to the public notice template. No vendor and no outside model.
answers.q6_description: The drafter turns a closure record into a plain-language notice for the public web page. It runs in the state data center. A traffic supervisor edits the notice before it is posted. Fictional system.
answers.q7_purpose: Today a traffic supervisor writes each closure notice by hand. The drafter proposes the text so posting is faster. The supervisor still approves every notice. Fictional purpose.
answers.q8_how: A wrong notice could send drivers toward a closed road or away from an open one.
answers.q14_sources: Public road-closure records from the traffic notice unit.
answers.q20_harm: A draft notice could name the wrong detour. Drivers would lose time or enter a work zone. The traffic supervisor can stop a notice before it posts.
